docs.title: Atlas
docs.text: Atlas is a tool provided by Rte and developped by Artelys to simulate power market such as spot market, intraday, reserves.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
This project is under development. There is no public release. To use it :

git clone https://github.com/rte-france/ATLAS.git

Then, install uv and set up your environment :

uv sync
